tspan.tspan: Hospital travel burden for urban and rural residents

text.style: font-family: OpenSans; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;
font-family: OpenSans; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;

tspan.tspan: Data source: Hospital Morbidity Database (CIHI, 2018-2023), Statistics Canada (2024)
Factors that impact travel burden include patient living in a different census subdivision than the hospital, greater
travel distance required, no road available, patient is a senior or child, and hospitalization is urgent or unscheduled.
